edits.before: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover: matchup-defining — The berserk wave turns your team on itself — never group in a line against it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep Q Howling Gale banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
